{{Quote|I am also invoking the Koru Act and requisitioning funds from the Senator's account.|Warlan Tosk|<ref name="Insecurities">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040513|text=Insecurities|int=Insecurities}}</ref>}}
The '''Koru Act''' was a law that was enforced during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the bodyguard [[Warlan Presvere Tosk|Warlan Tosk]] invoked the Koru Act while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], after he discovered a [[veshet]] that had been sent to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], the world's representative to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
